```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Macro forecast evaluation workbench (projects/forecast-evaluation). Every number comes from
// /data/forecast_eval.json, computed at build time by pipeline/exhibits/forecast_eval.py from the
// archived per-origin forecast records; nothing is estimated in the browser. Cells are prefixed fe_;
// the page places their outputs with inline ${...} expressions.
fe_data = FileAttachment("/data/forecast_eval.json").json().catch(() => null)
fe_S = ({
  en: {
    version: "Output version", horizon: "Horizon", model: "Model compared with M2", window: "Comparison window",
    own: "Each model's own window", common: "Common window (all models)",
    h3: "3 months", h6: "6 months",
    v_latest: "Latest archived run (24 Feb 2026, sample from 2001)", v_summary: "Research-summary run (23 Feb 2026, sample from 2005)", v_observed: "Latest inputs, trained only on outcomes observed by the origin (smoothed inputs unchanged)",
    v_latest_on_summary_window: "Latest run, scored on the research-summary run's common window (from 2020-01)",
    m6_note: "M6 (M4v2) exists only in the latest run; the research-summary run is shown for M4 instead.",
    m5_note: "M5 has the fewest origins, so its matched origins with M2 are the common window; switching the window changes only the error table.",
    built: "computed at build time", nested: "nested models: indicative only",
    failed: "Interactive data failed to load. The static figure and the static table below show the default view.",
    smoothed: "Smoothed state-space estimate (uses the whole sample)", band: "68% band of the smoothed estimate",
    rolling: "Rolling 120-month estimate (backward-looking)", threshold: "Signal threshold (25th percentile, pre-2020)",
    signal: "Durable low-persistence signal on (from the smoothed estimate)",
    services: "Services CPI, 12-month rate (D7NN)", goods: "Goods CPI, 12-month rate (D7NM)",
    persistence_y: "Persistence (AR coefficient)", cpi_y: "12-month rate (%)",
    model_col: "Model", n: "n", first: "First origin", last: "Last origin", rmse: "RMSE (pp)", mae: "MAE (pp)", dir: "Direction hit rate", rel: "RMSE vs M2",
    rel_matched: "RMSE vs M2, matched origins", rel_archived: "Archived table (M2 on its own origins)", scroll: "Scrollable table",
    base: "baseline", month: "Month", cum_y: "Cumulative loss differential, model − M2",
    show_table: "Show the numbers behind the chart", origin: "Forecast origin", cum: "Cumulative difference",
    state0: "Signal off", state1: "Signal on", na: "n/a"
  },
  zh: {
    version: "输出版本", horizon: "预测期", model: "与 M2 比较的模型", window: "比较窗口",
    own: "各模型自身窗口", common: "共同窗口（全部模型）",
    h3: "3 个月", h6: "6 个月",
    v_latest: "最新存档版本（2026 年 2 月 24 日，样本始于 2001 年）", v_summary: "研究摘要版本（2026 年 2 月 23 日，样本始于 2005 年）", v_observed: "最新输入、仅用起点前已观测结果训练（平滑输入未改）",
    v_latest_on_summary_window: "最新版本，按研究摘要版本的共同窗口计分（2020-01 起）",
    m6_note: "M6（M4v2）只在最新版本中存在；研究摘要版本改为显示 M4。",
    m5_note: "M5 的起点最少，它与 M2 的配对起点就是共同窗口；切换窗口只改变误差表。",
    built: "构建时计算", nested: "嵌套模型：仅供参考",
    failed: "交互数据加载失败。下方的静态图和静态表显示默认视图。",
    smoothed: "状态空间平滑估计（使用全样本）", band: "平滑估计的 68% 区间",
    rolling: "滚动 120 个月估计（只用过去数据）", threshold: "信号阈值（2020 年前的第 25 百分位）",
    signal: "持久低持续性信号开启（由平滑估计得出）",
    services: "服务业 CPI 同比（D7NN）", goods: "商品 CPI 同比（D7NM）",
    persistence_y: "持续性（AR 系数）", cpi_y: "同比（%）",
    model_col: "模型", n: "n", first: "首个起点", last: "最后起点", rmse: "RMSE（百分点）", mae: "MAE（百分点）", dir: "方向命中率", rel: "相对 M2 的 RMSE",
    rel_matched: "相对 M2 的 RMSE（配对起点）", rel_archived: "存档表口径（M2 取自身起点）", scroll: "可横向滚动的表格",
    base: "基准", month: "月份", cum_y: "累计损失差：模型 − M2",
    show_table: "显示图中数据", origin: "预测起点", cum: "累计差",
    state0: "信号关闭", state1: "信号开启", na: "无"
  }
})
fe_s = (k) => fe_S[LANG][k] ?? fe_S.en[k] ?? k
fe_minus = (s) => s.replace(/^-/, "−")
fe_num = (x, d = 3) => x == null || Number.isNaN(x) ? fe_s("na") : fe_minus(x.toFixed(d))
fe_pct = (x) => x == null || Number.isNaN(x) ? fe_s("na") : (Math.abs(x) < 0.005 ? "0.00%" : (x > 0 ? "+" : "−") + Math.abs(x).toFixed(2) + "%")
fe_months = (start, n) => { const [y, m] = start.split("-").map(Number); return Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1 + i, 1))) }
fe_ym = (d) => `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(d.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`
fe_modelName = (k) => { const m = fe_data.models.find((d) => d.key === k); return m ? (LANG === "zh" ? m.zh : m.en) : k }
fe_versionName = (v) => fe_s(`v_${v}`)
fe_hName = (h) => fe_s(h === "3m" ? "h3" : "h6")
fe_w = Math.max(300, Math.min(760, width))
fe_longDate = (iso) => { const d = new Date(iso); if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return iso
  const m = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]
  return LANG === "zh" ? `${d.getUTCFullYear()} 年 ${d.getUTCMonth() + 1} 月 ${d.getUTCDate()} 日` : `${d.getUTCDate()} ${m[d.getUTCMonth()]} ${d.getUTCFullYear()}` }
fe_built = fe_data && fe_data.meta.built_at ? (LANG === "zh" ? `：${fe_longDate(fe_data.meta.built_at)}` : `: ${fe_longDate(fe_data.meta.built_at)}`) : ""
// Plot SVGs: expose the aria-label to all screen readers (Safari/VoiceOver ignores it without a role).
fe_img = (node) => { (node.tagName && node.tagName.toLowerCase() === "svg" ? [node] : node.querySelectorAll("svg[aria-label]")).forEach((g) => g.setAttribute("role", "img")); return node }
fe_colors = ({ smoothed: "#18557f", rolling: "#8a6a1a", services: "#18557f", goods: "#8a6a1a", model: "#18557f", muted: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)", band: "rgba(24,85,127,0.16)", signal: "rgba(0,0,0,0.06)" })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof fe_version = Inputs.radio(["latest", "summary", "observed"], { label: fe_s("version"), value: "latest", format: fe_versionName })
viewof fe_h = Inputs.radio(["3m", "6m"], { label: fe_s("horizon"), value: "3m", format: fe_hName })
viewof fe_model = Inputs.select(["M4", "M3", "M5", "M6", "M1", "M0"], { label: fe_s("model"), value: "M4", format: (k) => fe_data ? `${k} ${fe_modelName(k)}` : k })
viewof fe_window = Inputs.radio(["common", "own"], { label: fe_s("window"), value: "common", format: (w) => fe_s(w) })
```

"左图：服务业通胀持续性的平滑估计及其 68% 区间与滚动 120 个月估计；右图：最新版本、3 个月、共同窗口下 M4 减 M2 的累计平方误差差。" : "Left: smoothed estimate of services-inflation persistence with its 68% band and the rolling 120-month estimate. Right: cumulative squared-error difference, M4 minus M2, latest run, 3 months, common window."}"></div>`
```{ojs}
  : html``
fe_controls = {
  if (fe_data === null) return html``
  // Name each radio group for assistive technology. The inputs keep the library's name attribute (each group
  // sits in its own <form>, so the groups do not interfere, and the library looks its inputs up by that name).
  for (const [v, k] of [[viewof fe_version, "version"], [viewof fe_h, "horizon"], [viewof fe_window, "window"]]) {
    const g = v.querySelector("div")
    if (g) { g.setAttribute("role", "radiogroup"); g.setAttribute("aria-label", fe_s(k)) }
  }
  const sel = viewof fe_model.querySelector("select")
  if (sel) sel.setAttribute("aria-label", fe_s("model"))
  return html`<div class="fe-controls" id="fe-controls" role="group" aria-label="${LANG === "zh" ? "比较设置" : "Comparison settings"}">
  ${viewof fe_version}${viewof fe_h}${viewof fe_model}${viewof fe_window}
</div>`
}
fe_m = fe_version === "summary" && fe_model === "M6" ? "M4" : fe_model
fe_ver = fe_data ? fe_data.versions.find((v) => v.id === fe_version) : null
fe_ev = fe_data ? fe_data.eval[fe_version][fe_h] : null
fe_pair = fe_ev ? fe_ev.pairs[fe_m][fe_window] : null
fe_state = fe_data === null ? html`` : html`<p class="fe-state" aria-live="polite"><strong>${LANG === "zh" ? "当前视图：" : "Current view:"}</strong> ${fe_versionName(fe_version)} · ${fe_hName(fe_h)} · ${fe_m} ${LANG === "zh" ? "对" : "vs"} M2 · ${fe_s(fe_window)}${fe_m !== fe_model ? html` · <em>${fe_s("m6_note")}</em>` : ""}${fe_m === "M5" ? html` · <em>${fe_s("m5_note")}</em>` : ""}</p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Step 1: persistence (latest archived run) and services vs goods CPI. Not affected by the controls.
fe_per = fe_data ? fe_data.persistence : null
fe_perRows = {
  if (!fe_per) return []
  const sm = fe_per.smoothed, ro = fe_per.rolling
  const xs = fe_months(sm.start, sm.rho.length)
  const rStart = fe_months(sm.start, sm.rho.length).findIndex((d) => fe_ym(d) === ro.start)
  return xs.map((d, i) => ({ date: d, rho: sm.rho[i], lo: sm.lo[i], hi: sm.hi[i], signal: sm.signal[i],
    rolling: i >= rStart && rStart >= 0 ? ro.rho[i - rStart] : null, rolling_se: i >= rStart && rStart >= 0 ? ro.se[i - rStart] : null }))
}
fe_signalSpans = {
  const out = []; let s = null
  fe_perRows.forEach((r, i) => {
    if (r.signal === 1 && s === null) s = r.date
    if ((r.signal !== 1 || i === fe_perRows.length - 1) && s !== null) { out.push({ x1: s, x2: r.signal === 1 ? fe_months(fe_ym(r.date), 2)[1] : r.date }); s = null }
  })
  return out
}
fe_cpiRows = fe_per ? fe_months(fe_per.cpi.start, fe_per.cpi.services.length).map((d, i) => ({ date: d, services: fe_per.cpi.services[i], goods: fe_per.cpi.goods[i] })) : []
fe_swatch = (color, dash, label) => html`<span class="fe-key"><svg width="26" height="10" aria-hidden="true"><line x1="0" y1="5" x2="26" y2="5" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-dasharray="${dash ?? ""}"></line></svg>${label}</span>`
fe_box = (fill, label) => html`<span class="fe-key"><svg width="18" height="10" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="18" height="10" fill="${fill}"></rect></svg>${label}</span>`
fe_persistChart = {
  if (!fe_per) return html``
  const first = fe_perRows[0].date, last = fe_perRows[fe_perRows.length - 1].date
  const rmin = Math.min(...fe_perRows.map((r) => r.lo), ...fe_perRows.filter((r) => r.rolling != null).map((r) => r.rolling))
  const rmax = Math.max(...fe_perRows.map((r) => r.hi), ...fe_perRows.filter((r) => r.rolling != null).map((r) => r.rolling))
  const p1 = Plot.plot({
    width: fe_w, height: 290, marginLeft: 48, marginRight: 14, marginTop: 26, marginBottom: 30,
    style: { fontFamily: "inherit", fontSize: 11, overflow: "visible" },
    ariaLabel: LANG === "zh" ? "服务业通胀持续性：平滑估计与滚动估计" : "Services-inflation persistence: smoothed and rolling estimates",
    ariaDescription: LANG === "zh"
      ? `平滑估计 ${fe_per.smoothed.start} 至 ${fe_per.smoothed.end}，取值 ${fe_num(Math.min(...fe_per.smoothed.rho), 2)} 至 ${fe_num(Math.max(...fe_per.smoothed.rho), 2)}；滚动估计 ${fe_per.rolling.start} 至 ${fe_per.rolling.end}；阈值 ${fe_num(fe_per.threshold, 3)}；信号开启 ${fe_per.smoothed.signal.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)} 个月。`
      : `Smoothed estimate ${fe_per.smoothed.start} to ${fe_per.smoothed.end}, between ${fe_num(Math.min(...fe_per.smoothed.rho), 2)} and ${fe_num(Math.max(...fe_per.smoothed.rho), 2)}; rolling estimate ${fe_per.rolling.start} to ${fe_per.rolling.end}; threshold ${fe_num(fe_per.threshold, 3)}; signal on in ${fe_per.smoothed.signal.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)} months.`,
    x: { type: "utc", domain: [first, last], label: null },
    y: { label: fe_s("persistence_y"), domain: [Math.floor(rmin * 20) / 20, Math.ceil(rmax * 20) / 20], grid: true },
    marks: [
      Plot.rectX(fe_signalSpans, { x1: "x1", x2: "x2", fill: fe_colors.signal }),
      Plot.areaY(fe_perRows, { x: "date", y1: "lo", y2: "hi", fill: fe_colors.band }),
      Plot.ruleY([fe_per.threshold], { stroke: fe_colors.muted, strokeDasharray: "2 3" }),
      Plot.lineY(fe_perRows, { x: "date", y: "rho", stroke: fe_colors.smoothed, strokeWidth: 1.8 }),
      Plot.lineY(fe_perRows.filter((r) => r.rolling != null), { x: "date", y: "rolling", stroke: fe_colors.rolling, strokeWidth: 1.5, strokeDasharray: "6 3" }),
      Plot.tip(fe_perRows, Plot.pointerX({ x: "date", y: "rho", title: (r) => `${fe_ym(r.date)}\n${LANG === "zh" ? "平滑" : "smoothed"} ${fe_num(r.rho, 3)} [${fe_num(r.lo, 3)}, ${fe_num(r.hi, 3)}]\n${LANG === "zh" ? "滚动" : "rolling"} ${r.rolling == null ? fe_s("na") : fe_num(r.rolling, 3)}` }))
    ]
  })
  const p2 = Plot.plot({
    width: fe_w, height: 200, marginLeft: 48, marginRight: 14, marginTop: 24, marginBottom: 30,
    style: { fontFamily: "inherit", fontSize: 11 },
    ariaLabel: LANG === "zh" ? "服务业与商品 CPI 同比" : "Services and goods CPI, 12-month rates",
    ariaDescription: LANG === "zh"
      ? `ONS 数据 ${fe_per.cpi.start} 至 ${fe_per.cpi.end}；最近一个月服务业 ${fe_per.cpi.services.at(-1)}%，商品 ${fe_per.cpi.goods.at(-1)}%。`
      : `ONS data ${fe_per.cpi.start} to ${fe_per.cpi.end}; latest month services ${fe_per.cpi.services.at(-1)}%, goods ${fe_per.cpi.goods.at(-1)}%.`,
    x: { type: "utc", label: null },
    y: { label: fe_s("cpi_y"), grid: true },
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: fe_colors.muted }),
      Plot.lineY(fe_cpiRows, { x: "date", y: "services", stroke: fe_colors.services, strokeWidth: 1.6 }),
      Plot.lineY(fe_cpiRows, { x: "date", y: "goods", stroke: fe_colors.goods, strokeWidth: 1.4, strokeDasharray: "6 3" }),
      Plot.tip(fe_cpiRows, Plot.pointerX({ x: "date", y: "services", title: (r) => `${fe_ym(r.date)}\n${LANG === "zh" ? "服务业" : "services"} ${r.services}%\n${LANG === "zh" ? "商品" : "goods"} ${r.goods}%` }))
    ]
  })
  return fe_img(html`<div class="fe-chart">
    <div class="fe-keys">${fe_swatch(fe_colors.smoothed, null, fe_s("smoothed"))}${fe_box(fe_colors.band, fe_s("band"))}${fe_swatch(fe_colors.rolling, "6 3", fe_s("rolling"))}${fe_swatch(fe_colors.muted, "2 3", fe_s("threshold"))}${fe_box("rgba(0,0,0,0.12)", fe_s("signal"))}</div>
    ${p1}
    <div class="fe-keys">${fe_swatch(fe_colors.services, null, fe_s("services"))}${fe_swatch(fe_colors.goods, "6 3", fe_s("goods"))}</div>
    ${p2}
  </div>`)
}
fe_persistTable = {
  if (!fe_per) return html``
  const cpi = new Map(fe_cpiRows.map((r) => [fe_ym(r.date), r]))
  return html`<details class="fe-details"><summary>${fe_s("show_table")}</summary><div class="table-scroll fe-scroll" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="${fe_s("scroll")}"><table class="tbl-num">
    <thead><tr><th>${fe_s("month")}</th><th>${LANG === "zh" ? "平滑估计" : "Smoothed"}</th><th>${LANG === "zh" ? "68% 下限" : "68% low"}</th><th>${LANG === "zh" ? "68% 上限" : "68% high"}</th><th>${LANG === "zh" ? "信号" : "Signal"}</th><th>${LANG === "zh" ? "滚动估计" : "Rolling"}</th><th>${LANG === "zh" ? "服务业 CPI（%）" : "Services CPI (%)"}</th><th>${LANG === "zh" ? "商品 CPI（%）" : "Goods CPI (%)"}</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>${fe_perRows.map((r) => { const c = cpi.get(fe_ym(r.date)); return html`<tr><td>${fe_ym(r.date)}</td><td>${fe_num(r.rho, 3)}</td><td>${fe_num(r.lo, 3)}</td><td>${fe_num(r.hi, 3)}</td><td>${r.signal}</td><td>${r.rolling == null ? "—" : fe_num(r.rolling, 3)}</td><td>${c ? c.services : "—"}</td><td>${c ? c.goods : "—"}</td></tr>` })}</tbody>
  </table></div></details>`
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Step 2: coverage of each model's own window and the common window (reacts to version and horizon).
fe_coverage = {
  if (!fe_ev) return html``
  const models = fe_ver.models
  const rows = models.map((k) => ({ k, a: fe_months(fe_ev.own[k].first, 1)[0], b: fe_months(fe_ev.own[k].last, 2)[1], n: fe_ev.own[k].n }))
  const ca = fe_months(fe_ev.common.first, 1)[0], cb = fe_months(fe_ev.common.last, 2)[1]
  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: fe_w, height: 40 + 26 * models.length, marginLeft: 44, marginRight: 70, marginTop: 8, marginBottom: 28,
    style: { fontFamily: "inherit", fontSize: 11 },
    ariaLabel: LANG === "zh" ? "各模型的伪样本外预测起点覆盖范围" : "Pseudo-out-of-sample coverage of forecast origins by model",
    ariaDescription: (LANG === "zh" ? `共同窗口 ${fe_ev.common.first} 至 ${fe_ev.common.last}，n = ${fe_ev.common.n}。` : `Common window ${fe_ev.common.first} to ${fe_ev.common.last}, n = ${fe_ev.common.n}. `) + rows.map((r) => `${r.k}: ${fe_ev.own[r.k].first}–${fe_ev.own[r.k].last}, n = ${r.n}`).join("; "),
    x: { type: "utc", label: null },
    y: { domain: models, label: null },
    marks: [
      Plot.rectX([{ a: ca, b: cb }], { x1: "a", x2: "b", fill: "rgba(24,85,127,0.12)" }),
      Plot.barX(rows, { x1: "a", x2: "b", y: "k", fill: (r) => r.k === fe_m ? fe_colors.model : r.k === "M2" ? "#444" : "#b3b3b3", insetTop: 6, insetBottom: 6 }),
      Plot.text(rows, { x: "b", y: "k", text: (r) => `n = ${r.n}`, dx: 6, textAnchor: "start" })
    ]
  })
  return fe_img(html`<div class="fe-chart"><div class="fe-keys">${fe_box("rgba(24,85,127,0.12)", (LANG === "zh" ? "共同窗口：" : "Common window: ") + `${fe_ev.common.first} – ${fe_ev.common.last}, n = ${fe_ev.common.n}`)}</div>${chart}</div>`)
}
```

```{ojs}
// Step 3: errors table for the chosen version, horizon and window.
fe_errors = {
  if (!fe_ev) return html``
  const own = fe_window === "own"
  const rowOf = (k) => own ? fe_ev.own[k] : fe_ev.common.models[k]
  const head = own
    ? (LANG === "zh" ? `${fe_versionName(fe_version)}，${fe_hName(fe_h)}，各模型自身窗口：每个模型在它有预测的全部起点上计分，n 和起止月份各不相同；主比值取该模型与 M2 共有的起点。` : `${fe_versionName(fe_version)}, ${fe_hName(fe_h)}, each model's own window: every model is scored on all origins where it has a forecast, so n and dates differ; the main ratio uses the origins the model shares with M2.`)
    : (LANG === "zh" ? `${fe_versionName(fe_version)}，${fe_hName(fe_h)}，共同窗口：所有模型在同一批起点上计分（${fe_ev.common.first} 至 ${fe_ev.common.last}，n = ${fe_ev.common.n}）。` : `${fe_versionName(fe_version)}, ${fe_hName(fe_h)}, common window: all models scored on the same origins (${fe_ev.common.first} to ${fe_ev.common.last}, n = ${fe_ev.common.n}).`)
  return html`<div>
    <div class="note"><strong>${head}</strong></div>
    <div class="table-scroll" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="${fe_s("scroll")}"><table class="tbl-num fe-errors">
      <thead><tr><th>${fe_s("model_col")}</th><th>${fe_s(own ? "rel_matched" : "rel")}</th>${own ? html`<th style="color:var(--muted);font-weight:400">${fe_s("rel_archived")}</th>` : ""}<th>${fe_s("n")}</th>${own ? html`<th>${LANG === "zh" ? "起点范围" : "Origins"}</th>` : ""}<th>${fe_s("rmse")}</th><th>${fe_s("mae")}</th><th>${fe_s("dir")}</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>${fe_ver.models.map((k) => { const r = rowOf(k)
        // own windows: the main ratio is on the origins the model shares with M2 (fe_ev.pairs[k].own.rel_pct);
        // the archived-table ratio divides by M2's RMSE on all of M2's own origins (fe_ev.own[k].rel_pct)
        const main = k === "M2" ? fe_s("base") : fe_pct(own ? fe_ev.pairs[k].own.rel_pct : r.rel_pct)
        return html`<tr class="${k === fe_m ? "fe-sel" : k === "M2" ? "fe-base" : ""}"><td>${k} ${fe_modelName(k)}</td><td>${main}</td>${own ? html`<td style="color:var(--muted)">${k === "M2" ? "—" : fe_pct(fe_ev.own[k].rel_pct)}</td>` : ""}<td>${r.n}</td>${own ? html`<td style="white-space:nowrap">${fe_ev.own[k].first}–${fe_ev.own[k].last}</td>` : ""}<td>${fe_num(r.rmse)}</td><td>${fe_num(r.mae)}</td><td>${fe_num(r.dir, 2)}</td></tr>` })}</tbody>
    </table></div>
  </div>`
}
```

```{ojs}
  + (nested ? (LANG === "zh" ? `（${fe_s("nested")}）` : ` (${fe_s("nested")})`) : "")
```
